fix.item: Kemas kini 5.4.11.2 / 6.2.1.2 sentiasa muncul semula selepas dipasang: pakej v2 di downloads.joomla.org mengandungi manifest bertanda 5.4.11.1 / 6.2.1.1. Pakej v3 mempunyai versi yang betul, jadi kemas kini berhenti selepas dipasang.
Pakej v2 juga memasang installation_ms-MY.zip, yang mencipta semula folder installation/ pada laman. Pakej v3 hanya mengandungi laman, pentadbir dan API.

addition.item: Terjemahan awal untuk 11 kunci baharu Joomla 6.3: pemilih fail, folder, imej dan video (JLIB_FORM_SELECT_*, JLIB_FORM_CHANGE_*), dua ralat jenis menu, dan saiz ubah saiz imej mengikut folder (plg_media-action_resize). Liputan 100% berbanding 6.3-dev.
Changelog pakej boleh dilihat dalam Joomla: Sistem → Urus → Sambungan → Changelog.

fix.item: Susun atur ZIP subpakej bahasa supaya sepadan dengan manifest rasmi Joomla (<folder>/</folder>).

Manifest sumber install.xml (site, administrator, api) kini memasang seluruh folder seperti en-GB. Senarai fail lama merujuk api/.../lib_joomla.ini yang telah dipadam (pemasangan API gagal) dan tertinggal 12 fail pentadbir, termasuk lawatan berpandu Joomla 6 dan PoW Captcha.
"baharu" instead of "baru" for new in the site language file, "Pemalam" instead of "Plugin" in plugin descriptions, "penerangan" in sample data.
"Pembalut" for the Wrapper component (same as the module), "Skema" in the Schema.org plugin, "Sistem - HTTP Headers" plugin name (HTTP Headers stays untranslated as en-GB requires).

addition.item: Terjemahan untuk enam kunci en-GB yang diperkenalkan atau belum disertakan dalam Joomla 5.4.11 dan 6.2.1.

change.item: Pakej disasarkan kepada Joomla 5.4.11 dan 6.2.1.
Pakej binaan tidak lagi menyertakan installation_ms-MY.zip. Client installation dipetakan ke folder installation/, jadi pemasangannya mencipta semula folder itu pada laman produksi.
Manifest sumber install.xml menggunakan hak cipta Joomla! Malaysia dan authorUrl penuh.

remove.item: 626 obsolete keys and api/language/ms-MY/lib_joomla.ini. None of them exist in Joomla 5.4.11, 5.4-dev, 6.2.1 or 6.2-dev, including wrong TPL_CASSIOPEIA_POSITION_* duplicates with underscores instead of hyphens.

fix.item: JACTION_ADMIN now reads "Konfigurasi ACL & Pilihan" (it was truncated to "Konfigurasi").
Installation password message uses %d like en-GB.
Consistent terminology across the pack: "pengatasan" for override, "penerangan" for description, "didaftar masuk" for checked in, "Daftar Masuk" for Check-in.
Labels that added words not in the source (e.g. "Fail Audio" → "Audio", "Hari Relatif" → "Tarikh Relatif").

addition.item: All new strings for Joomla 5.4.10 and 6.2.0. The pack is at 100 % key coverage against 5.4-dev and 6.2-dev.
Early translations for strings coming in Joomla 6.2.1: Smart Search ARIA label, Cassiopeia Extended, scheduler orphan filter, keyboard-shortcut timeout and the TOTP QR code alt text.
title attributes on links in user action log, privacy and consent messages (Joomla 6.2 accessibility change).

Joomla 6 specific overrides (overrides/j6/) for strings whose placeholders differ from Joomla 5, so the uninstall messages show the extension type and name, and accessible media labels show the media type.
